generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

Mandatorily satisfactorily completed, as Prime Contractor, at least one Similar Work (Similar in nature of work should be RCC Framed Structure buildings of Value of the Work not less than Rs. 59.63 Lakh. In support of this, the Tenderer shall furnish a Certificate duly certified by the Competent Authority not below the Rank of Executive Engineer along with the Technical Bid. Further, the value of the Completed Works of the Previous Years shall be given a Weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the Price Level of 2026 27-

Executed in any one Year (for a Continuous Period of 12 Months), the following minimum quantities of Work.Concrete (PCC/RCC)175.00 Cum Reinforcement TMT Steel 19.80 MT SBM/BBM/SSM/Block work 136.00 Cum PLastering 1125.00 Sqm Painting 1610.00 Sqm Flooring(Vitrified/Granite/Ceramic/Cladding)500.00Sqm

The tenderer or his identified sub-contractor should possess required valid electrical license for executing building electrification works and should have executed similar works totaling Rs. 8.38 Lakhs in any one Financial year.

Mandatorily registered with the Employees State Insurance Corporation and Employee Provident Fund. In support of this, the Tenderer shall upload Registration certificates and paid challanas from last 3 months along with the Technical Proposal, failing to comply with these Norms will make the Tender liable to Rejection
Liquid Assets and / or availability of Credit Facilities of no less than Rs. 39.75 Lakh (Credit Lines / Letter of Credit / Certificates from Banks for meeting the Fund Requirement, etc.).

The Tenderer shall without fail visit the proposed site and sign the attendance register placed in the proposed construction site and submit the Feasibility report regarding men, material & completion of work to Asst. Manager-Projects GTTC, Bangalore and obtain due acknowledgement for the same on or before 25 - 11 - 2026 up to 17:30 hrs, and upload the acknowledged document along with Technical Bid.
PWD CERTIFICATE CLASS III AND ABOVE

The Tenderer shall without fail visit the proposed site and sign the attendance register placed in the proposed construction site and submit the Feasibility report regarding men, material & completion of work to Asst. Manager-Projects GTTC, Bangalore and obtain due acknowledgement for the same on or before 25 - 11 - 2026 up to 17:30 hrs, and upload the acknowledged document along with Technical Bid

To qualify for Award of this Contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021 -22 to 2025 -26. Achieved in at least two Financial Years a minimum Average Annual Financial Turnover (in all classes of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs. 238.52 Lakh. Tenderer should upload scanned statement of Turn over Certificate with UDIN Certified by Chartered Accountant and along with profit and loss statement and face sheet of ITR for the block period 2021 22 to 2025 26 compulsorily. Financial Turnover will be considered on Contract Receipts only
